newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks slide amid political concerns.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks slide amid political concerns.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange's general index was down 5.27 percent half an hour before the market's close on Tuesday amid political concerns and a round of profit-taking, brokers said.
The selective index of blue-chip shares also fell sharply by 5.15 percent. The biggest individual loser was the mining concern Morococha SA, off about 10 percent at 9.49 soles.
